Frequently Asked Questions

How can we help you?

Booking & Payment

Booking is simple.
Message us on WhatsApp (fastest) or use the Contact page. Please include your car size, postcode, and the package you’re interested in.

We currently accept cash and bank transfer. Payment is taken once the job is complete unless agreed otherwise.

We ask for at least 24 hours’ notice if you need to cancel or reschedule. Late cancellations may affect priority booking availability.

Yes. If we’re detailing two or more vehicles at the same location, we can offer discounted pricing. Message us for a custom quote.
